stories.headline: Japanese Market Modestly Higher
stories.body: (RTTNews) - The Japanese stock market is trading modestly higher on Tuesday, extending the gains in the previous session, following the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight, with the Nikkei 225 moving above the 70,150 level, with gains in automakers, financial stocks.

stories.headline: Frozen or stolen? BofA customer struggles to get money back
stories.body: Kyle Horn, the owner of a precious-metals dealer in San Diego, says his Bank of America account, which had about $50,000 in it, has been frozen for 18 months. He's suing to get his money back — and to win protections for other customers like him.

stories.headline: FTC Chairman Urges Healthcare Services Companies to Ensure Price Transparency
stories.body: Healthcare services companies must provide patients with pricing information that is timely, accurate and complete, Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Chairman Andrew N. Ferguson said in letters sent to 24 of the largest such companies in the nation.
